content:
“You see beauty in the rubbish.”

**Pack Rat** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increased reduction of weight of all held junk items.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | The weight of all junk items is reduced by 75%. | 0038AB99 | 
| ★ | 1 | The weight of all junk items is reduced by 50%. | 0038AB98 | 

- This perk does not affect the weight of junk items stored in a stash box. Any junk placed in the stash returns to its default weight.
- Before update 58, Pack Rat had 3 ranks that reduced junk weight by 25%/50%/75%.
